    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            if r in (r0, r1) or c in (c0, c1):
                if out[r][c] == bg:
